name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; descriptor accurately reflects body (applies MP heal then accumulates heal XP). No Ghidra address residue in suffix. Parallel-named with sibling fd2_apply_hp_heal_and_award_xp.
purpose: Apply an MP heal to one combatant (rc[target_idx]) and accumulate heal XP for the player side; return the actual MP amount restored.
logic_summary: mp_before/mp_max read from runtime_char array. base_heal_90 = base*9/10; after fd2_advance_rng_state(), extra_heal = (rng%100 * base)/1000 giving a 90%..100% effective heal. mp_after = min(mp_max, mp_before + base_heal_90 + extra_heal); stored back to mp_current. If portrait_id < 0x4B (player side), pending_xp_credit += level(status_flags_block[0]) * 0x28 * mp_gained / mp_max. Unlike the HP twin there is NO +30 mid-tier (job 9..24) bonus added to level. Returns extra_heal + base_heal_90.

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Target combatant index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr. Caller passes the target runtime_char id from the per-target loop in fd2_apply_use_effect_dispatch effect code B.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic decompiler placeholder param_1, which does not reflect purpose; src already uses target_idx. Rename applied in Stage 2.

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Base MP heal amount = item effect_param (u16 at pItem+0xE) passed by the caller; scaled by the 90%..100% RNG formula.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is generic placeholder param_2; src already uses base_heal. Rename applied in Stage 2.

returns.semantics: Actual MP restored = base_heal_90 + extra_heal (the pre-clamp 90%..100% computed heal, not the clamped delta). Consumed by the sole caller as the value shown via fd2_show_damage_number(value, 0x69, target) for the MP-restore number display.

comment_original_issue: Original src comment was correct but terse: it omitted the explicit XP credit formula and the return-value semantics that the sibling HP comment documents.
notes: Sole caller fd2_apply_use_effect_dispatch @0x20c6f effect code B (回MP), guarded by wMP_max!=0 before the call. Return value feeds fd2_show_damage_number(value,0x69,target). The body tail-jumps (JMP 0x1C9C7) into fd2_apply_hp_heal_and_award_xp's shared XP/epilogue label; this is a codegen detail captured in the Ghidra plate and not contradicted by the src comment. Ghidra plate is detailed and consistent with refined understanding, so left untouched.
